title: Resolution opposing luxury Project Esencia in Cabo Rojo, Puerto Rico
summary: This resolution states that the City Council stands with the people of Puerto Rico in opposing construction of Project Esencia, a planned $2 billion luxury hotel and residential development covering over 2,000 acres and three miles of beaches in Cabo Rojo. It cites environmental, archaeological and community concerns raised by local protesters and groups, including strain on water supplies, harm to endangered species and gentrification. It calls for stopping the project's construction.
